mapper.select: SELECT id FROM student WHERE id=#{studentId} AND status='ACTIVE' FOR NO KEY UPDATE

SELECT s.spot_no::int AS spot_no,i.code AS item_key,i.name AS name,i.asset_key AS asset_key FROM room_decor_spot s JOIN look_item i ON i.id=s.look_item_id WHERE s.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY s.spot_no

SELECT i.id AS item_id,i.code AS code,i.name AS name,i.asset_key AS asset_key,count(*)::int AS owned FROM student_room_decor d JOIN look_item i ON i.id=d.look_item_id WHERE d.student_id=#{studentId} GROUP BY i.id,i.code,i.name,i.asset_key
